notes.title: AWAKEN — Astral Blade | New Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/f286b28e783a31fadb1148eb3ea51c8944ad3891.png"][/img][/p][p]
Hello everyone![/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update, but the time has come! We’re excited to bring you a brand-new patch for [b]Awaken - Astral Blade[/b], focusing on gameplay polish, boss rebalancing, and level design improvements. Your feedback continues to be a vital part of our development process – thank you![/p][p]Let’s take a look at what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p]🖥 PC-Specific Updates[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bugs related to the Karpas organism[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized post-processing (Bloom effect) for improved visual clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted screen shake effect for better comfort[/p][/*][*][p]New setting added: You can now toggle screen shake on/off in the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck improvements: Enlarged all in-game text for better readability[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare save issue where players had a small chance of losing items[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-map fixes – task markers now display correctly[/p][/*][/list][p]⚔️ Boss Balancing[/p][list][*][p]Mech Mutant Prototype: Weakened knockback effect to make encounters more fair[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-Infiltration Model: Reduced damage and duration of specific skills[/p][/*][*][p]Flame Tyrant M9γ / Frozen Regent M9γ: Adjusted skill damage and cooldowns for improved pacing[/p][/*][*][p]The Despairing Spirit: Toxic spores will no longer knock players down[/p][/*][/list][p]🧭 Level Design Enhancements[/p][list][*][p]Electric ball traps no longer knock the player down[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy distribution rebalanced for smoother combat flow[/p][/*][*][p]More moving platforms now allow jumping through[/p][/*][*][p]Drone chase sequence redesigned for a better gameplay experience[/p][/*][*][p]Overhanging-Rock Peak area: Jump paths improved for smoother traversal[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility around the Karpas organism – no more missing dropped items[/p][/*][*][p]New dialogue added after Tania leaves the lab[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠 Other Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Multi-GamePad support bug has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal content fix: Christmas trees will now remain silent outside of the holiday season[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Resolved issues affecting the mini-map displayThank you to everyone who has already purchased AWAKEN — Astral Blade! If you’re enjoying the game, we’d love to hear from you — leave us a review here on Steam, post in the [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716310/discussions/"]community discussions[/url][/b], or chat with us on [b][url="https://linktr.ee/ESDGames"]our official ESDigital social media accounts[/url][/b].  We’ll continue working to bring you new content and an even better game experience in the days ahead!  [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

[list][*] New outfit - The Dream Set (press the action button while standing still to dash forward, then instantly perform an elegant backward dodge). The Dream Set is Renée's favorite outfit. This outfit is not only visually stunning but also perfectly suited for both battles and exploration. Made from lightweight yet durable materials, it offers exceptional comfort to its wearer.

notes.title: AWAKEN - Astral Blade | Update #2 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/f286b28e783a31fadb1148eb3ea51c8944ad3891.png[/img]

Greetings all players!

Our second patch containing multiple adjustments, improvements, and fixes is now available to download. Please update the game to the latest version for the best possible experience.

Full patch notes are listed below:

[list]
[*]Added new combos, skills, abilities and weapon enhancements for Tania, to make her stronger (you can use combos starting from Fall Attack or Ruthless Onslaught).
[*]During the auto-play of dialogue, the wait time has been extended, so you won’t have to worry about missing any text.
[*]Save points will now be correctly marked by a cat icon even when inactive.
[*]Revival speed has been improved, significantly reducing the display time of the death screen.
[*]The combo interface has been improved, making it easier to see how to perform specific combos.
[*]The “Return to last save point” function has been unified with the revival system, allowing you to retain acquired loot and unlocked mini-maps.
[*]Added a training dummy in the village. Everyone can go to Gathi’s house to test out their combos.
[*]Balance changes (reduced the basic damage bonus for each Golden Octopus, improving the final game bosses, adjusted the properties of some ornaments. and others).
[*]And many other bug fixes, general optimization improvements, and much more.[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has already purchased AWAKEN — Astral Blade. Let us know what you think about the game by writing a review here on Steam, posting it in [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716310/discussions/]the Discussions[/url][/b], or chat with us on [b][url=https://linktr.ee/ESDGames]the official ESDigital social media accounts[/url][/b]. We'll keep working to improve AWAKEN - Astral Blade and provide you with a better game experience as well as new content in the coming days!

notes.title: The first AWAKEN - Astral Blade patch and New Halloween costume are here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/f286b28e783a31fadb1148eb3ea51c8944ad3891.png[/img]

Greetings all players!

Since the launch of AWAKEN - Astral Blade, we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions from you, our community, streamers, your Steam reviews, and discussions on other social media platforms. After carefully gathering, analyzing, and discussing your feedback, we made the decision to improve the early game experience and several convenience mechanics while retaining the core gameplay of AWAKEN - Astral Blade.

Our first patch brings a range of adjustments, improvements, and fixes — and it's now available to download. Please update the game to the latest version for the best possible experience and claim a new [b]FREE[/b] Halloween costume. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248914/a2b507fcf76269a725df3632031b0b0c0d96b533.png[/img]
Thank you to everyone who has already purchased AWAKEN — Astral Blade. Let us know what you think about the game by writing a review here on Steam, posting it in [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716310/discussions/]the Discussions[/url][/b], or chat with us on [b][url=https://linktr.ee/ESDGames]the official ESDigital social media accounts[/url][/b]. Our journey is just beginning, and we can’t wait to share more information and updates with you.

Full patch notes are listed below:

[list][*] New Halloween costume — Witchcraft Set (Karpas Energy Acquisition Speed is increased by 20%)!
[*] All available NPCs and cats will now appear on the minimap as separate mini-icons when approaching them.
[*] Hardcore game mode is now available when you first start the game.
[*] Improved and refined the parry effect in conjunction with its skill.
[*] Optimized the time-slowing effect when hitting an enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue where some bosses could hit when they shouldn't or behave incorrectly in combat.
[*] The mouse cursor automatically hides on the screen when a controller is connected.
[*] Fixed an issue where some puzzles could be more complex and not display correctly on the screen.
[*] Fixed and improved camera placement in some cutscenes.
[*] Fixed an issue where purchasing items in the store would not add items to the backpack. You will automatically receive all missing items after updating the game.
[*] Updated and improved the drone pursuit mission guide (it will now be much harder for you to get lost).
[*] New Feature: Jump Challenge Assistance. Provides players with extra help for difficult jump sections in the game.
[*] And many other bug fixes, general optimization improvements, and much more.[/list]
Thank you for all of your comments and suggestions! We'll keep working to improve AWAKEN — Astral Blade and provide you with a better game experience as well as new content in the coming days!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/
